summary: Fifty proposals ruled, 45 pass and 5 fail (90%). The reader's work is careful and its quotes are real; line numbers drift by a few in places (Portamento, Biomechanical, Creative Coach, Matplotlib) but every quoted sentence is on the page it names, so no lane is voided. The failures share one shape: the reader looked hard for a hidden reason when proposing labels, and less hard when proposing cuts or tie-breaks. Two cuts miss a reason under another name — Wallpaper Groups' open question about sonifying 'the way you sonify a quantum wavefunction', and the Dialogue Moderator's pheromone sentences, whose board is the running system STIGMERGY now is. One label (Shepard Tone → Frequency-Time Duality) is the reader's own inference with no sentence on either page, and the reader already rated it low. One retype (Founding Conversation enables Prism) makes a lineage claim the Prism Context's own dates contradict; exemplifies is what the source says. One pair judgment keeps a stated link for false reasons: Synth Templates does name the curvature page in its body, and the deposit's reciprocal ran the other way. Passes I would watch: the SUBSTRATE-anatomy labels (Image Embedding Standard especially) rest on organ membership alone, and Four Pillars of Enchanted Agency → Swarm Weave is better as deepens than as a label.
